flow.title: Your ownership loop
flow.subtitle: Four simple moves from “I should remember this” to “I know what happens next.”

examples.title: Everyday questions. Clear next steps.
examples.lead: You stay in charge. AssetFlow turns the details you already have into a practical plan you can review, confirm, and keep up to date.

item1.quote: “Where is the receipt, and what needs doing next?”
item1.help: Keep the document with the right asset, then see the next confirmed task without searching through drawers, inboxes, or memory.

item2.quote: “Did we already take care of this?”
item2.help: Record completed work as it happens, so everyone in the household can see what was done and when.

item3.quote: “I bought a used car. What should I check first?”
item3.help: Add the car, attach its service history, and review a smart maintenance plan before confirming the dates that matter to you.

item4.quote: “The washing machine is acting up. Can I find the warranty?”
item4.help: Link the receipt, warranty, and notes to the appliance so the evidence is ready when you need it.

item5.help: Build a plan for the boiler, heat pump, bike, or home system, then choose what to confirm and when.

item6.quote: “Where are the solar-panel documents, and when should we check them?”
item6.help: Keep the installation records and service notes with the home, then track the next review without relying on a folder or a reminder in your head.

library.title: One library for the story of every asset
library.lead: Keep the documents that explain ownership close to the asset and the moments that matter. AssetFlow is designed to bring the paper trail into the same place as your plan and history.

item1.title: Asset documents
item1.body: Attach manuals, warranties, insurance, and service contracts to the asset they belong to.

item2.title: Event documents
item2.body: Keep receipts, invoices, service reports, and photos with the maintenance or ownership event they support.

item3.title: Find what helps next
item3.body: See the evidence behind your history, spot missing details, and use what you learn to improve the next plan.

library.note: Keep documents connected to the asset or event they support, so the evidence stays ready when you need it.

tree.label: Example asset library
tree.title: 2020 Toyota Corolla
tree.caption: Asset documents and event evidence stay together, with the original file types intact.

smartPlan.title: A smart maintenance plan in seconds
smartPlan.lead: Give AssetFlow the context you already have. It turns that information into a practical draft you can review, adjust, and approve.

preview.note: You decide what becomes part of your plan.

calendar.title: Keep your maintenance schedule in sync
calendar.body: Bring approved maintenance into the calendar you already use, so everyone sees what is due and the right person can act. Connected calendar sync is being prepared.
calendar.benefit1: See what is due at a glance

how.title: You stay in control. AssetFlow helps with the rest.

step1.title: Start with one asset
step1.body: Add a car, appliance, bike, home system, tool, or anything else you look after.

step2.title: Get a smart maintenance plan
step2.body: AssetFlow uses the details you provide to prepare suggested tasks, dates, and reminders.

step3.title: Review and make it yours
step3.body: Edit, remove, or confirm each suggestion. Nothing is added or changed until you approve it.

step4.title: Stay ahead with a living history
step4.body: Record what you complete and build the history that helps you make the next decision with confidence.

categories.title: Start with one thing. Feel more in control of everything.
categories.note: Warranties, insurance policies, and service contracts stay linked to the asset they belong to, with their own dates and reminders.

pricing.title: Choose the space that fits your life
pricing.lead: Start free, then choose more assets, smart-plan credits, or household collaboration when you need them. All plans are billed in EUR.

plus.name: Plus
plus.tagline: More room and a bit of collaboration.

pro.name: Pro
pro.tagline: More capacity for a growing household.

pricing.note: Active assets are the assets you track at the same time; archived assets do not count toward the limit. AI credits are shared across chat, smart maintenance plans, and decisions, and do not roll over month to month.

security.title: Your records stay protected and under your control
security.lead: Ownership information is personal. AssetFlow is built to help you organize it with clear controls, reviewable AI, and European hosting for the current deployment.

pillar1.title: Encrypted connections
pillar1.body: Every connection to AssetFlow uses HTTPS encryption in transit.

pillar2.title: You decide what changes
pillar2.body: AI suggestions are drafts. Nothing is added or changed until you review and confirm it.

pillar3.title: European hosting
pillar3.body: The current AssetFlow deployment runs on European infrastructure. We do not claim certifications or broader compliance guarantees that have not been verified.
